summary: Set up a LUKS2-encrypted, file-backed volume on node1 mounted at /srv/secure that unlocks and mounts automatically at boot, then validated it survives a real node restart.
actions_performed: Created a 1G sparse image /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img and a root-only random keyfile /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/srv-secure.key (mode 600)
Formatted the image as LUKS2 with cryptsetup luksFormat using the keyfile
Added a crypttab entry (srv_secure) referencing the image file and keyfile with 'luks,nofail'; systemd-cryptsetup-generator built systemd-cryptsetup@srv_secure.service from it
Opened the mapping, created an ext4 filesystem on /dev/mapper/srv_secure, created /srv/secure, and added a matching /etc/fstab entry (defaults,nofail)
Mounted the volume and wrote a test file to confirm read/write access
Captured a pre-restart baseline (boot_id, mount state, LUKS status, file content)
Triggered a single non-destructive systemctl reboot on node1, polled until exec access returned
Verified boot_id changed (proving an actual restart), then confirmed systemd-cryptsetup@srv_secure.service was active, /srv/secure was mounted, and the test file content survived with no manual steps

evidence.requirement: Encrypted volume exists and is LUKS2-backed
evidence.summary: cryptsetup luksFormat --type luks2 succeeded on the image file (LUKS header dump shows Version 2), confirming the volume is properly encrypted

evidence.requirement: Volume is mounted at /srv/secure and usable
evidence.summary: mount output shows /dev/mapper/srv_secure on /srv/secure type ext4; a test file was written and read back successfully

evidence.requirement: Volume unlocks and mounts automatically at boot without manual steps
evidence.summary: Pre-restart baseline captured (boot_id e8afb731..., mounted, data present); reboot triggered and acknowledged before disconnect; after polling reconnection, verified without any manual cryptsetup/mount commands that systemd-cryptsetup@srv_secure.service was active and /srv/secure was mounted with the same test file content intact

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: changed boot identity
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from e8afb731-420c-4162-a989-583aca271335 (pre-restart) to 3776d739-ea41-461b-961f-f8cddbd0ba88 (post-restart), proving a genuine restart occurred, not just a service restart

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: post-restart cluster/service health and data recovery
evidence.summary: Post-restart check shows systemd-cryptsetup@srv_secure.service active, LUKS mapping active via /dev/loop0, ext4 filesystem mounted at /srv/secure, and the previously written test file content ('hello-secure') intact
